title: 第5章 制作鱼篓第6章 食物中毒
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
李秦武看现在的天色还早，回部落只能趴地上吃草，并不打算立刻回去，想先打野发育一波。
他看准一个方向，和哥布矛说了句跟上就带头朝前走，如果他没记错的话，这个方向有条河。
李秦武吃草的半个月里，一直仔细观察哥布林狩猎队的动态，他发现从北边回来的狩猎队带的猎物鱼货居多，他就判断北边有河流，捕鱼可比抓其他小动物简单多了。
他的判断是正确的，两人往北边走了七八公里，一条超级大河映入视野。
李秦武被震惊到了，从他站立的岸边看去，只能模糊看见对岸，这条大河宽度目测超过5km了！
更让他感觉恐怖的是，他看见大河中有某种大鱼高高跃起，然后砸到水面激起剧烈的水柱，就像炮弹在水中炸开一样！
“我勒个异世界啊！”
李秦武估计那庞然大物体长超百米了，哪怕隔着这么远，都让他感觉毛骨悚然！
他当即带着哥布矛远离岸边，别等这庞然大物上岸，一口把他俩当瓜子嗑了。
他并没有回头就走，而是带着哥布矛沿河岸寻找小支流，大河有巨怪不能靠近，那就去小支流，看看能不能搞些小鱼。
功夫不负有心人，两人很快找到了一条小支流，河水非常清澈，能看到许多鱼在里面游，资源相当丰富。
哥布矛见状兴奋的大喊一声，直接跳进小河中，想徒手抓鱼。
李秦武翻了个白眼，抓鱼要是这么容易，哥布林部落也不用同类相食了。
果不其然，哥布矛忙活了好一会儿，什么都没抓到，把自己弄得一身湿，倒是将身上的臭味清理了个干净。
哥布矛悻悻然上岸，感觉有些沮丧，可他突然看到岸边居然有螺蛳在爬，是动物就能吃，他抓起一个螺蛳就扔嘴里。
“卧槽！”
李秦武见这个逼乱吃东西，一个巴掌扇他脸上，用力之大直接把他打的原地旋转三周半，他嘴里的螺蛳也吐了出来。
李秦武掐着哥布矛的脖子疯狂摇晃。
“你踏马找死啊！这东西里全是寄生虫！小心把你吃死啊！”
哥布矛懵逼的捂着红肿不堪的脸，楚楚可怜的看着李秦武，显然没明白自己为什么被打。

李秦武是知道的，有些成年哥布林经常会捂着肚子疼的嚎叫，没过几天就死了，还有的哥布林会疯狂拿头撞树，把自己撞死。
这些症状都是哥布林们吃生食导致的，要么就是寄生虫进入肠胃肝脏，要么是进入大脑，发展到后期身体里全是寄生虫，活活疼死了。
哥布矛不知道什么是寄生虫，一副委屈的模样，李秦武懒得和他解释，只说了句没有自己的命令不准乱吃东西。
李秦武指着森林。
“去找些平直的树枝和藤条过来，越多越好！”
哥布矛哦了一声，跑进森林，不一会儿，他抱着一堆木棍藤条跑了回来。
“老大，你要这些东西干嘛？又不能吃？”
“它们不能吃，但能抓吃的，你好好看，跟我学着做！”
李秦武接过树枝藤条操作起来，不一会儿，一个简易鱼篓被做了出来。
哥布矛不知道这东西干嘛用的，可他的学习能力超强，模仿李秦武的动作同样制作了一个鱼篓。
李秦武再次感叹哥布林的学习能力，他接过两个鱼篓，用草绳将他们绑住，从河边捡了几个大螺丝，用石块砸碎，将螺肉扔进鱼篓，草绳拴在一根树枝并插地上，鱼篓直接扔小河里。
然后两人略微退远，静静等待着。
等待的过程中，两人的肚子发出叽叽咕咕的声音，尤其是哥布矛，一整天啥东西都没吃，就跟着他在山里跑了。
李秦武见他神情萎靡的模样，怕他关键时刻又闹低血糖掉链子，于是从仓库里拿了一袋谷物，抓了一把放他手上。
“吃！”
哥布矛惊讶于李秦武凭空取物的能力，心中疑惑他是怎么办到的？
他看向手上不知道什么东西的谷物，一口将其塞进嘴里，然后丑脸就皱成了苦瓜。
系统爆出来的谷物是没脱壳的小麦，哥布林虽然是杂食动物，但更偏向吃肉，一下吃到这种没啥味道还硌牙的东西，让他差点吐出来。
李秦武见他要浪费粮食，巴掌高高的举起。
content_en:
Li Qinwu saw that it was still early and he could only lie down on the ground to eat grass when he returned to the tribe. He did not plan to go back immediately. He wanted to do some jungle development first.
He spotted a direction, told Gob Mao to follow him and took the lead. If he remembered correctly, there was a river in this direction.
During the half month that Li Qinwu was eating grass, he had been carefully observing the movements of the Goblin hunting team. He found that the hunting team returning from the north brought mostly fish and prey. He concluded that there was a river in the north, and fishing was much easier than catching other small animals.
His judgment was correct. The two walked seven or eight kilometers north, and a huge river came into view.
Li Qinwu was shocked. Looking from the bank where he stood, he could only vaguely see the other bank. The width of this river was more than 5km by visual inspection!
What made him even more frightened was that he saw some kind of big fish leaping high in the river, then hitting the water and causing a violent water column, just like a cannonball exploding in the water!
"I'm going to create a different world!"
Li Qinwu estimated that the huge object was over a hundred meters long. Even from such a distance, it made his hair stand on end!
He immediately took the Gob Spear away from the shore, not waiting for this huge creature to come ashore and eating the two of them like melon seeds.
He didn't turn around and left, but took the Gob Spear along the river bank to look for small tributaries. There were giant monsters in the big river that couldn't be approached, so he went to the small tributaries to see if he could catch some small fish.
Their hard work paid off, and the two quickly found a small tributary. The water was very clear, and many fish could be seen swimming in it. The resources were quite rich.
When Gob Mao saw this, he shouted excitedly and jumped directly into the river, trying to catch the fish with his bare hands.
Li Qinwu rolled his eyes. If catching fish was so easy, the goblin tribe wouldn't need to eat cannibalism.
As expected, Gob Mao worked hard for a while, but didn't catch anything. He got himself wet, but he managed to clean up the stench from his body.
Gob Mao came ashore angrily, feeling a little depressed, but suddenly he saw snails crawling on the shore. Animals can eat them. He grabbed a snail and threw it into his mouth.
"Fuck!"
When Li Qinwu saw this pervert eating food indiscriminately, he slapped him in the face with such force that he spun him three and a half times and spit out the snails in his mouth.
Li Qinwu grabbed Gobu Mao's neck and shook it wildly.
"You're looking for death on horseback! This thing is full of parasites! Be careful, I'll eat you to death!"
Gobu Mao covered his red and swollen face in confusion, looking at Li Qinwu pitifully, obviously not understanding why he was beaten.
Li Qinwu knew that some adult goblins would often cover their stomachs and howl in pain and die within a few days. Some goblins would crazily hit their heads against trees and kill themselves.
These symptoms are all caused by goblins eating raw food. Either the parasites enter the intestines, stomach, liver, or brain. In the later stage, the body is full of parasites and it hurts to death.
Gob Mao didn't know what a parasite was, and looked aggrieved. Li Qinwu didn't bother to explain to him, and just said that he was not allowed to eat without his own orders.
Li Qinwu pointed to the forest.
"Go find some straight branches and canes, the more the better!"
Gobmao yelled and ran into the forest. After a while, he ran back holding a pile of sticks and rattan.
"Boss, why do you want these things? You can't eat them?"
"They can't eat, but they can catch food. Look at it and learn from me!"
Li Qinwu took the branches and rattan and started operating it. After a while, a simple fish basket was made.
Gobu Mao didn't know what this thing was used for, but he had a strong learning ability and imitated Li Qinwu's movements to make a fish basket.
Li Qinwu once again lamented the goblin's learning ability. He took the two fish baskets and tied them with straw ropes. He picked up a few large screws from the river, smashed them with stones, and threw the snail meat into the fish baskets. The straw ropes were tied to a branch and inserted into the ground. The fish baskets were directlyThrow it into the river.
Then the two of them stepped back slightly and waited quietly.
While waiting, the stomachs of the two of them made gurgling sounds, especially Gob Spear. They didn't eat anything all day long, so they ran around in the mountains with him.
Seeing his depressed look, Li Qinwu was afraid that he would suffer from hypoglycemia at the critical moment, so he took a bag of grain from the warehouse, grabbed a handful and put it in his hand.
"Eat!"
Gobu Mao was surprised by Li Qinwu's ability to retrieve objects out of thin air, and wondered how he did it?
He looked at the unknown grain in his hand, stuffed it into his mouth, and then his ugly face wrinkled into a bitter melon.
The grains that popped out of the system were unhulled wheat. Although the Goblin was an omnivore, he preferred to eat meat. He almost vomited when he ate such a tasteless and tooth-gritting thing.
When Li Qinwu saw that he was going to waste food, he slapped his hands high in the air.
